note: generalizable. the question taxonomy, the outcome vocabulary, and the rules that turn evidence into an outcome. no cohort measurements - those live in {project_root}/routing_evidence.json, because a second cohort must not inherit them.

authority.note: same split as the EDA gate. what a routing decision rests on decides whether a new cohort may reuse it.

values.rule: the decision followed deterministically from the contract plus the cohort's recorded evidence. no model judgement entered it
values.model: a model mapped natural language onto a task_id. the route that followed was still a rule
values.human: escalated - the system declined to pick and a person recorded the choice

authority.why_this_matters: the routing rule is the same on every cohort; the evidence that resolves it is not. a cohort with no routing_evidence.json cannot be routed, and the system says so rather than reusing another cohort's winner.

outcomes.recommend: one candidate leads and its interval does not overlap the runner-up's
outcomes.tie: two or more candidates overlap within the declared interval. the system names all of them and does not pick
outcomes.refuse: the evidence contraindicates the named method, or no candidate clears the cohort's floor for this task
outcomes.disambiguate: the question maps onto more than one task family. the caller resolves it with the human before calling again - this tool is never asked to guess a level

tie_rule.description: candidates whose recorded interval overlaps the leader's are tied with it
tie_rule.basis: an ordering that a bootstrap interval does not separate is not an ordering. naming a single winner inside the overlap invents a precision the measurement does not have

refusal_rule.description: a method whose metric falls below the cohort's declared raw-modality floor is contraindicated for that task
refusal_rule.basis: a floor is the value the raw un-aligned modality already achieves. a method scoring under it has removed information rather than organized it - it is worse than doing nothing, not merely worse than the leader
refusal_rule.forecloses: reporting a method as the weakest option when the correct report is that it is anti-helpful

reference_rule.description: a reference is REPORTED, never decisive. it is the un-aligned modality's own score, carried so a reader can see what alignment bought. when the leader falls below it that shortfall leads the rationale; when the leader clears it, nothing is claimed
reference_rule.basis: a floor says the method removed information and is disqualifying. a reference says what the un-aligned modality already achieved and is not
reference_rule.interval_asymmetry: a reference is typically a single point estimate while candidates carry intervals. it therefore cannot be adjudicated by the tie rule, and 'clears the reference' must never be stated as a separated claim. report the shortfall, do not resolve on the absence of one
reference_rule.note: whether any cohort currently triggers this rule is a property of that cohort's evidence, not of the contract - look in routing_evidence.json. the rule is exercised by fixture in the test suite.

multi_metric_rule.description: a task may declare more than one metric. resolve each independently; if every metric names the same leader, recommend it. if they name different leaders, escalate - do not average, rank or pick one metric
multi_metric_rule.basis: two metrics that disagree are measuring two different things, and the task has not said which one it wants. picking either silently answers a question the caller did not ask. this is the interval rule one level up: a set of measurements that does not order the candidates is not an ordering
multi_metric_rule.forecloses: a leaderboard that hides a tradeoff by reporting whichever axis the winner happens to lead on

task_families.asks: given one modality's representation of a unit, find the matching unit in the other modality
do the two modalities' representations agree in geometry, not merely retrieve each other
group units into recurring tissue states within a section
represent biology while suppressing subject identity, for analysis pooled across subjects
carry a pathway-level signal onto subjects never seen in training
distinguish which of several pathways drives a specific unit, rather than detect pathway signal at all
predict a molecular signature from imaging alone, with no molecular assay at prediction time

guards.cross_subject_eval: held-out subjects only. within-subject evaluation reports subject identity as if it were method quality
guards.label_granularity: compute NMI(label, subject_id) before any clustering metric. a subject-level label makes clustering a subject-classification task
guards.paired_subject_z: pair every clustering or similarity claim with a biology-z vs subject-z test. a method can raise both
guards.raw_floor: compare against what the raw un-aligned modality already achieves, not only against other methods
guards.circularity_view: a view whose input encodes the signal being tested is circular. report the view that does not
guards.off_diagonal_specificity: detecting a signal and attributing it to the right source are different claims. a method with high off-diagonal similarity does the first and not the second
guards.untrained_control: include an untrained projection. a signal an untrained projection preserves was in the encoder, not created by training

evidence_contract.note: what {project_root}/routing_evidence.json must supply for a cohort to be routable. a missing task family is not routed - it escalates.
evidence_contract.absent_cohort_file: no routing. the system reports that this cohort has no recorded evaluation and declines to reuse another cohort's routing table.
evidence_contract.multi_metric_tasks: a task with more than one axis declares `metrics: [...]`, each block carrying its own metric, candidates, higher_is_better and optional floor/reference. a single-axis task keeps the flat shape and is read as one block.

how_a_question_reaches_a_task.note: this tool does not parse natural language. the caller (a model) reads task_families, picks the task_id, and asks the human when the level is genuinely ambiguous. what follows the task_id is deterministic.
how_a_question_reaches_a_task.model_step: question -> task_id, plus optional proposed_method when the asker names one
how_a_question_reaches_a_task.rule_step: task_id -> route, ties, refusal, guards - resolved from recorded evidence alone
how_a_question_reaches_a_task.why_split_here: the same question can be asked a hundred ways and must reach the same route. keeping interpretation in the model and resolution in the contract is what makes a model swap change fluency without changing a decision
